skill.summary: Assist yoga instructors and studios in creating personalized 60-90 second class preview and enrollment videos showcasing teaching style and class atmosphere.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Yoga Instructor Video skill.
- Assists yoga teachers and studios in creating student enrollment and class preview videos.
- Guides users through selecting video type (e.g., class preview, teacher introduction, studio tour).
- Collects essential class and teaching details to personalize video content.
- Generates 60–90 second video scripts with scene descriptions and b-roll suggestions.
- Provides filming prompts for natural, authentic class atmosphere and teacher-student interactions.
